description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS RTC driver for Renesas SmartBond hardware, implementing time setting, getting, and alarm functionalities.

methods.name: smartbond_rtc_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling RTC alarm and second events.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_set_status
methods.description: Enables or disables the RTC hardware.

methods.name: rtc_time_to_bcd
methods.description: Converts rtc_time structure to BCD format for RTC register.

methods.name: rtc_calendar_to_bcd
methods.description: Converts rtc_time structure to BCD format for calendar register.

methods.name: bcd_to_rtc_time
methods.description: Converts RTC register value from BCD to rtc_time structure.

methods.name: bcd_to_rtc_calendar
methods.description: Converts calendar register value from BCD to rtc_time structure.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_set_time
methods.description: Sets the RTC time and date.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_get_time
methods.description: Retrieves the current RTC time and date.

methods.name: alarm_calendar_to_bcd
methods.description: Converts alarm rtc_time to BCD calendar format.

methods.name: alarm_time_to_bcd
methods.description: Converts alarm rtc_time to BCD time format.

methods.name: bcd_to_alarm_calendar
methods.description: Converts BCD alarm calendar register to rtc_time.

methods.name: bcd_to_alarm_time
methods.description: Converts BCD alarm time register to rtc_time.

methods.name: tm_to_rtc_alarm_mask
methods.description: Converts alarm mask to RTC alarm enable register format.

methods.name: rtc_to_tm_alarm_mask
methods.description: Converts RTC alarm enable register format to alarm mask.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_alarm_set_time
methods.description: Sets an alarm time and mask.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_alarm_get_time
methods.description: Retrieves alarm time and mask.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_alarm_is_pending
methods.description: Checks if an alarm is pending.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_alarm_set_callback
methods.description: Sets callback for alarm events.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_alarm_get_supported_fields
methods.description: Gets supported alarm fields.

methods.name: rtc_smartbond_update_set_callback
methods.description: Sets callback for RTC update events.
